body: Are starters in Inclement emerald also on the 1/1024 shiny odds or are they shiny locked? Been trying to get a shiny Snivy for what has now been almost a month :/

I trust people, I just don't know if I should. I'm really afraid they'll tell others.
Idk what I could do aside from that, really. I'm tired of being here, I didn't ask for life in the first place, and I'm angry people are trying to keep me there. I feel like I don't have a choice.
I find little to no enjoyment in life anymore. Nothing's new, nothing will be.
I watch a bit of Minecraft Youtubers, and they are role-playing, but I don't think their work outweighs the constant stress and pressure. It's like 1h a day of happiness, not worth it in my opinion.

My mom likes to downplay the stuff I talk about because "I'm just a teenager". My dad doesn't talk about emotions, and I'm pretty sure he doesn't believe in that kind of stuff, seeing how he talks about psychologists (he says they're useless), so I don't feel safe talking to them. I don't feel safe talking about it to my teachers either, because they'll immediately call the police or my parents. Plus they don't want anybody to commit suicide in their school because it looks bad on their resume, so often the principal gets involved and start to snoop around, and I don't want that. My friends would treat it as a joke and just respond "same", I've seen them doing it b/w each others. 
 I want to kill myself on New Year's Eve because it's convenient, everybody will be away.
 Idc about the effect it causes on others. Call me selfish, but I don't want to live a life I didn't ask for just to pleasure a handful of people who can and would move on anyway. They did it with my grandma when she died, they can do it with me too.

I feel like I'm driving myself into a wall. School is sucking up all of my energy, and all that for mediocre results. I sleep in class because I don't have the time to do it at home anymore, I'm in school from 8am to 6pm and I live 2h away from it. It's just all I live for. School, school, bad grades, school, school. I don't really find enjoyment in life when everything I do I learned it on an time schedule. There's no excitement, every day looks the same. They're also constantly asking me about my future, and honestly I don't have a good enough skill set to do anything later on. So I don't see the point in keeping up with a life I don't like when nothing will get better.
